patch_description: Building on the highest-scoring seed (0.73, n_distinct_params=2, using a single "ry_a" pre-rotation parameter and a single shared "theta" parameter for the RZ layers plus the full ZZ connectivity shells), I apply the recommended edit: replicate the entire ZZ entanglement block (nearest-neighbor ring, opposite-qubit shell, and skip-2 shell) a second time immediately after the first occurrence, still exclusively using param="theta". This deepens the effective circuit (more entangling layers, closer to a multi-shell "hypercube" structure) without introducing any new trainable parameter name, which is the single biggest lever for score given that parameter economy dominates scoring at every count. Extra depth under a shared parameter can increase expressivity/nonlinearity of the effective feature map, which should help separate the hardest validation group (worst_group_margin) while keeping n_distinct_params at 2 for maximal parameter-efficiency score.
